name: denorm_preserve
description: Gradual underflow for requested floating-point preservation modes.
cost_note: Requested FP32 arithmetic uses native operations with an exponent/mantissa subnormal guard and a flushed-underflow check. Ordinary zero and normal results avoid integer repair; cancellation near the underflow boundary retains cold repair. Comparisons use native predicates unless an operand is subnormal. FP64 remains software.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both FP32 denorm controls for SM 6.2 and higher; only shaders requesting the modes pay the cost, and DXC default fp32 denorm mode any requests neither.
off_consequence: Without either FP32 denorm control, vkd3d-proton limits non-NVIDIA D3D12 devices to SM 6.1; SM 6.2 and higher are unavailable.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: only explicitly requested preservation emits guards; ordinary zeros and normal arithmetic use native operations, true or possibly flushed subnormals use cold repair, and comparisons use native predicates unless an operand is subnormal.

name: denorm_flush
description: Flush subnormal results to zero in requested floating-point modes.
cost_class: native arithmetic / ALU fixups / cold software repair
cost_note: FP32 arithmetic remains native. Multiply, FMA and divide test a zero result and repair finite normal nonzero operands through a cold correctly rounded fallback before final subnormal flushing. Selected non-arithmetic operations retain exponent-mask fixups. FTZ16 and FTZ64 remain unsupported.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both FP32 denorm controls for SM 6.2 and higher; only shaders requesting the modes pay the cost, and DXC default fp32 denorm mode any requests neither.
off_consequence: Without either FP32 denorm control, vkd3d-proton limits non-NVIDIA D3D12 devices to SM 6.1; SM 6.2 and higher are unavailable.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11 to retain SM6.8: requested flush modes use native arithmetic plus guarded cold repair; no family-specific removal of the repair path.

name: ray_tracing
description: Acceleration structures, ray queries and continuation-based ray-tracing pipelines. Host acceleration-structure commands, indirect acceleration-structure builds and shader group capture/replay handles are not provided; the vkd3d-proton ray tracing tier 1.1 path does not use them.
cost_note: AS construction is a compute build; bottom-level leaves are first sorted along a Morton curve of their centroids by a bitonic sort, one dispatch per merge step. Traversal is a stackless shader walk shared by ray queries and pipelines. Pipeline shaders run as continuation parts called from one dispatch kernel; invocation-private arrays and values live across calls in a device-memory frame per lane, accessed through untyped loads and stores. A direct launch larger than the lane arena runs as consecutive dispatches separated by barriers. Ray tracing pipelines are not captured into the binary archive, so every run compiles and links them cold; performance mode does not report ray tracing, so its pipeline caching is unchanged. Work is selected by RT commands and shaders.

property_bits.subgroupSupportedStages: VK_SHADER_STAGE_RAYGEN_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_ANY_HIT_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_CLOSEST_HIT_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_MISS_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_INTERSECTION_BIT_KHR | VK_SHADER_STAGE_CALLABLE_BIT_KHR

performance_reason: Ray-tracing interfaces require explicit selection.
off_consequence: Vulkan acceleration-structure, ray-query and ray-tracing pipeline interfaces and D3D12 DXR are unavailable; the RTXPT DXR path cannot run.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: the driver uses software traversal on every family; Apple9 hardware ray tracing is not consumed.

name: opacity_micromap
description: Opacity micromaps: per-micro-triangle opacity states for ray-traced triangles.
cost_note: A micromap build packs the triangle records in one invocation, then copies the states with one invocation per micromap triangle. Traversals compiled for pipelines created with the opacity micromap flag, and ray queries in shaders that declare the opacity micromap execution mode, test one flag per triangle candidate; a triangle with a micromap adds an index load, the micro-triangle index computation and one state load. Other ray-tracing shaders are compiled without the lookup. Serializing a bottom-level structure lists its micromap handles in one block; deserializing installs the application-patched handles with one more pass over the nodes.
performance_reason: Opacity micromaps require ray tracing, which requires explicit selection.
off_consequence: VK_KHR_opacity_micromap is unavailable; vkd3d-proton reports at most ray tracing tier 1.1 and shader model 6.8.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: software micromap build and lookup depend on software ray tracing.

name: invocation_reorder
description: Hit objects: recorded traces, misses and ray-query hits that a shader inspects and then executes.
cost_note: A traced hit object runs the ordinary traversal, then the scheduler writes the committed result (68 words) into the hit object in the caller's frame instead of entering closest-hit or miss. Executing a hit object loads those words into the call context and enters the closest-hit or miss shader as a callable. Execution is never reordered. Shaders without hit objects are unchanged.
performance_reason: Hit objects require ray tracing, which requires explicit selection.
off_consequence: VK_EXT_ray_tracing_invocation_reorder is unavailable; vkd3d-proton reports at most shader model 6.8.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: software hit-object frame traffic; no native reordering path.

name: pixel_interlock
description: Pixel interlock with cross-sample ordering for multisampled rendering.
cost_note: Sample interlock and single-sample pixel interlock use native raster order groups. Multisample pixel interlock captures coverage and inputs, then performs ordered load/replay/store passes in bounded tile and primitive batches with CPU/GPU continuation sequencing and scratch clearing. Cost scales with actual coverage, sample count and batch count.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires pixel and sample interlock for ROV support and D3D FL12_1; the multisample envelope is selected only for shaders using pixel interlock with multisampling.
off_consequence: Pixel interlock is unavailable, including its native single-sample route; vkd3d-proton loses ROV support and D3D FL12_1. Native sample interlock and ordered color attachment access remain available.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11 to retain FL12_1: native raster order groups for single-sample and sample interlock; multisample pixel interlock still uses the selected replay envelope.

name: pipeline_statistics
description: Pipeline-statistics queries backed by draw data and shader execution counters.
cost_note: An active fragment query adds a counter-address load and one 32-bit atomic increment, plus a carry atomic when the low word wraps. Other stages use draw data or instrumented execution. Inactive queries specialize the counter region away.
performance_reason: Wine vkd3d requires pipelineStatisticsQuery for feature level 11_1 and above. Inactive queries specialize away the counter operations.
off_consequence: Disabling pipelineStatisticsQuery limits Wine vkd3d to feature level 11_0 and removes pipeline-statistics queries; DXVK treats the feature as optional.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: An active fragment query adds a counter-address load and one 32-bit atomic increment, plus a carry atomic when the low word wraps. Other stages use draw data or instrumented execution. Inactive queries specialize the counter region away.

name: mesh_shader
description: Native object and mesh shaders with virtual task grids and sliced output when required.
cost_note: Each mesh workgroup stages outputs in threadgroup memory before copying them to the Metal mesh output. Ordinary direct mesh-only draws and bounded direct Task draws use one native render call with no compute dispatch. Indirect mesh-only draws add one slice-filter dispatch per logical draw. Indirect bounded Task draws add one GPU snapshot per logical draw and one filter dispatch per real batch. Unbounded Task draws use three compute dispatches per batch of at most 256 Task groups: prepare, Task body and real-prefix expansion. Eligible Apple9+ pipelines execute a GPU-written ICB range; other paths encode one indirect Mesh draw, then only real overflow slices, with at most 32 live overflow draws. Shader-sized payloads survive until all slices complete. Flat-output slices reset the canonical heap; retained depth-bounds paths keep capture and replay. Multiview repeats per view. Queries add counters only when used.
performance_reason: Apple9 and later select hardware object and mesh stages. Native direct draws stay native; unbounded Task grids engage bounded compute expansion only for pipelines that require it. Apple7 and Apple8 keep Mesh deselected because unbounded Task grids still need three compute dispatches per real batch and indirect inputs need a per-draw GPU snapshot. vkd3d-proton MeshTier1 also requires fragment barycentrics: Apple10-11 select both entries, while Apple9 selects Vulkan Mesh only.
off_consequence: D3D12 MeshTier1 and feature-level 12.2 are unavailable; mesh/task Vulkan shaders and mesh queries are unavailable. Lower feature levels remain subject to their other requirements; this entry does not remove a shader-model requirement or a translator device-creation prerequisite.
family_cost_note: On Apple9-11: ordinary direct Mesh and bounded direct Task use one native render call; unbounded Task uses prepare, Task compute and exact prefix/ICB expansion per real batch. Off Apple7-8: ordinary direct draws are also native, but unbounded Task still uses three compute dispatches per real batch plus a snapshot per indirect logical draw; the real overflow continuation bounds storage without removing that work.

name: polygon_points
description: Polygon POINT rasterization through captured primitive expansion.
cost_note: POINT emits two triangles per point after capture; FILL and eligible thin LINE draws retain native alternatives. Availability alone adds no shader code.
performance_reason: Preserve the non-solid fill feature selected by D3D translators; POINT cost is selected by actual polygon state.
off_consequence: Non-solid fill and dynamic polygon mode are unavailable, including native wireframe because Vulkan shares its feature bit with POINT. Translators lose non-solid fill support.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: POINT emits two triangles per point after capture; FILL and eligible thin LINE draws retain native alternatives. Availability alone adds no shader code.

name: line_expansion
description: Wide, rectangular, smooth and stippled Bresenham line rasterization.
cost_note: Selected wide/smooth/stipple lines capture vertices and emit expanded primitives; smooth lines add fragment alpha coverage and stipple adds dash generation. Thin default solid lines remain native.
performance_reason: Keeps translator-selected line features available; only line state that requires expansion selects the capture and expansion work.
off_consequence: Wide, rectangular, smooth and stippled Bresenham line features and their dynamic selectors are unavailable. Native thin Bresenham lines remain available.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Selected wide/smooth/stipple lines capture vertices and emit expanded primitives; smooth lines add fragment alpha coverage and stipple adds dash generation. Thin default solid lines remain native.

name: dynamic_coverage
description: Dynamic fragment sample mask and alpha-to-coverage lowering.
cost_note: Dynamic sample mask loads root state and filters coverage; nonconstant alpha-to-coverage computes a dither mask and demotes samples. Constant opaque alpha omits alpha coverage lowering. Rasterization sample count uses native attachment variants.
performance_reason: Keeps translator-selected dynamic coverage state available; coverage work is selected by the shader and pipeline state.
off_consequence: Dynamic sample-mask and alpha-to-coverage selectors are unavailable. Static coverage and native dynamic rasterization sample count remain available.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Dynamic sample mask loads root state and filters coverage; nonconstant alpha-to-coverage computes a dither mask and demotes samples. Constant opaque alpha omits alpha coverage lowering. Rasterization sample count uses native attachment variants.

name: dynamic_vertex_input
description: Runtime vertex attribute descriptions and format conversion for dynamic vertex input.
cost_note: Dynamic vertex inputs load format, divisor and stride metadata for consumed attributes and perform format-dependent conversion; static pipelines retain constant attribute specialization. Unused inputs emit no fetch work.
performance_reason: DXVK and vkd3d-proton retain static pipeline vertex input without requiring this interface.
off_consequence: Dynamic vertex-input pipelines must use static vertex layouts instead. D3D shader-model, feature-level and translator device-creation support remain available through static input.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: Dynamic vertex inputs load format, divisor and stride metadata for consumed attributes and perform format-dependent conversion; static pipelines retain constant attribute specialization. Unused inputs emit no fetch work.

name: multiview_geometry_tessellation
description: Original-view replay for geometry and tessellation multiview producers.
cost_note: Advanced multiview producers execute for each active view using the original view index; single-view and ordinary native vertex amplification remain separate paths. Emitted producer instructions are repeated by view count, with a per-draw view load when used.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton reports ViewInstancingTier 2 on KosmicKrisp only when both features are present, because its tier predicate accepts tiler suspend/resume only for drivers in its tiler list; only pipelines with a view mask and a geometry or tessellation stage replay the producer per view, which matches the per-view draws an application issues without view instancing.
off_consequence: Geometry and tessellation multiview producers are unavailable, vkd3d-proton reports ViewInstancingTier as not supported, and vkd3d-proton rejects view-instanced pipeline states with geometry or tessellation stages.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: only pipelines with a view mask and a geometry or tessellation stage replay the producer once per active view with a per-draw view load; other pipelines compile and run unchanged.

name: quad_control
description: Full-quad helper invocation and quad derivative control around native quad operations.
cost_class: native quad operations / helper merge guard
cost_note: Native quad and subgroup instructions are retained. A shader requiring full or coarse quad helper invocations can add the existing barycentric triangle-merge guard, or a sample-mask output when no color store exists; unused helper requirements emit neither guard.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires shaderQuadControl together with maximal reconvergence to advance from SM 6.6 to SM 6.7 and later; only affected fragment requirements select the helper guard.
off_consequence: vkd3d-proton cannot expose SM 6.7 or later through its ordinary quad-control and reconvergence path when the earlier SM 6.6 requirements are satisfied.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Native quad and subgroup instructions are retained. A shader requiring full or coarse quad helper invocations can add the existing barycentric triangle-merge guard, or a sample-mask output when no color store exists; unused helper requirements emit neither guard.

name: texel_buffer_alignment
description: Single-texel-offset buffer views over aligned native textures and raw buffer addresses.
cost_note: Typed native buffer access adds logical range comparison, prefix addition and invalid-coordinate selection; dynamic RGB32 views also select stride and fetch consumed components. Raw/R64 and sparse accesses retain required range and residency work. Unused shaders emit no texel-view code.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires both single-texel alignment promises for D3D12 device creation at the supported 16-byte native alignment; only shaders accessing texel-buffer views pay the adjustment cost.
off_consequence: vkd3d-proton v3.1 rejects D3D12 device creation when either single-texel alignment promise is absent at 16-byte alignment, making all D3D12 feature levels unavailable.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Typed native buffer access adds logical range comparison, prefix addition and invalid-coordinate selection; dynamic RGB32 views also select stride and fetch consumed components. Raw/R64 and sparse accesses retain required range and residency work. Unused shaders emit no texel-view code.

name: cull_distance
description: Whole-primitive rejection from cull distances written by the final pre-raster shader.
cost_note: Mesh shaders use native primitive rejection. Ordinary producers writing cull distances use capture and an all-vertex negative test per plane before clipping; each tested vertex loads one scalar distance, and testing stops at the first nonnegative or NaN value. No cull output selects no cull capture.
performance_reason: DXVK requires shaderCullDistance for translator device creation; capture is selected only by actual final-producer cull output.
off_consequence: DXVK cannot create its D3D device without shaderCullDistance; Vulkan cull-distance shader support is unavailable.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Mesh shaders use native primitive rejection. Ordinary producers writing cull distances use capture and an all-vertex negative test per plane before clipping; each tested vertex loads one scalar distance, and testing stops at the first nonnegative or NaN value. No cull output selects no cull capture.

name: non_seamless_cube
description: Face-local cube sampling without filtering across cube faces.
cost_note: Dynamic cube samples use the shared sampler-emulation function constant; the false specialization retains native cube sampling. Actual non-seamless use projects to a 2D-array face sample with quotient-rule gradients.
performance_reason: Legacy non-seamless cube sampling requires explicit selection.
off_consequence: DXVK rejects content requesting non-seamless cube sampling when the interface is unavailable.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: Dynamic cube samples use the shared sampler-emulation function constant; the false specialization retains native cube sampling. Actual non-seamless use projects to a 2D-array face sample with quotient-rule gradients.

name: sparse_translation
description: Sparse-buffer residency checks and standard-shaped sparse image adaptation for 3D images and for 2D images with storage usage or block-texel views.
cost_class: native placement / software address and volume translation
cost_note: Native placement and mapping remain native. The scalar buffer page-status helper emits three 64-bit metadata loads, two byte-status loads, bounds checks and a conditional branch, in addition to directory/range lookup and the resource access. Standard-shaped 3D accesses, and accesses to 2D residency images with storage usage or block-texel views, translate coordinates and select page storage, with copies or blits on relevant operations; filtered samples of those images combine fetched texels. 2D translation is compiled only into linked vertex and compute pipelines after such a 2D image exists. Unused shader operations emit no translation.
performance_reason: DXVK and vkd3d-proton require sparse buffer residency for every tiled-resources tier, and vkd3d-proton reports tiers 3 and 4 only with standard-shaped 3D sparse residency; removing it lowers the D3D feature-level ceiling (vkd3d-proton feature level 12_2 requires tier 3). Translation is selected by actual sparse resources and shader interfaces.
off_consequence: Sparse buffer residency and sparse 3D image residency are unavailable, including standard-shaped 3D blocks; DXVK and vkd3d-proton report no tiled-resources tier, and feature levels requiring one are unavailable (vkd3d-proton reports at most 11_1). Native sparse binding, aliasing, 2D residency and native texture residency status remain available when supported; 2D residency images then use native placement for every usage, without the standard 2D block shape, and 2D block-texel views of compressed sparse images are unavailable.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Native placement and mapping remain native. The scalar buffer page-status helper emits three 64-bit metadata loads, two byte-status loads, bounds checks and a conditional branch, in addition to directory/range lookup and the resource access. Standard-shaped 3D accesses, and accesses to 2D residency images with storage usage or block-texel views, translate coordinates and select page storage, with copies or blits on relevant operations; filtered samples of those images combine fetched texels. 2D translation is compiled only into linked vertex and compute pipelines after such a 2D image exists. Unused shader operations emit no translation.

name: robustness2
description: Exact out-of-bounds buffer and image access behavior and null descriptors.
cost_class: native access / bounds and null guards
cost_note: Selected bounded buffer loads use bounds predicates and zero/default selection; selected image and null accesses use guards. Unused operations emit no checks.
performance_reason: DXVK 2.x/3.x requires VK_EXT_robustness2 and nullDescriptor for device creation and uses robustBufferAccess2/robustImageAccess2; vkd3d-proton also requires nullDescriptor. Required buffer bounds and null semantics remain enabled.
off_consequence: DXVK 2.x/3.x and vkd3d-proton device creation fails when required nullDescriptor/robustness2 support is hidden. Both extension aliases and their three features are hidden; core robustness and pipeline robustness remain available.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Selected bounded buffer loads use bounds predicates and zero/default selection; selected image and null accesses use guards. Unused operations emit no checks.

name: workgroup_zero
description: Zero initialization of shader workgroup memory when requested by the shader.
cost_note: A requested nonempty shared allocation is rounded to 16 bytes and cooperatively cleared with native stores followed by a workgroup barrier. No clear or barrier is emitted without the shader zero-init flag and nonzero shared size.
performance_reason: Workgroup initialization is required by translator shader semantics; retain it for DXVK/vkd3d device creation and shader translation. Shaders without requested shared initialization emit no zeroing stores or barriers.
off_consequence: DXVK/vkd3d device creation fails when required workgroup-zero support is unavailable; the extension and promoted shaderZeroInitializeWorkgroupMemory feature are hidden. Allocation zero initialization and robustness are unchanged.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: A requested nonempty shared allocation is rounded to 16 bytes and cooperatively cleared with native stores followed by a workgroup barrier. No clear or barrier is emitted without the shader zero-init flag and nonzero shared size.

name: depth_bias_control
description: Exact and alternate-representation depth bias after primitive clipping.
cost_class: native default / geometry capture and replay
cost_note: Exact or alternate-format bias captures producer output and runs polygon clipping, bias expansion and raster replay. Default-format constant, slope and clamp bias uses native Metal state. Dynamic factor pipelines retain capture and native alternatives.
performance_reason: DXVK and vkd3d-proton retain their default bias paths without the optional exact and alternate-representation controls.
off_consequence: Exact and alternate-representation Vulkan bias control is unavailable. Native default-format bias and depthBiasClamp remain available; D3D shader-model, feature-level and translator device-creation requirements are unchanged.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: Exact or alternate-format bias captures producer output and runs polygon clipping, bias expansion and raster replay. Default-format constant, slope and clamp bias uses native Metal state. Dynamic factor pipelines retain capture and native alternatives.

name: float64
description: Binary64 floating-point arithmetic and comparisons.
cost_note: Only actual FP64 operations are lowered to integer and FP32 algorithms; equality uses branchless 32-bit integer operations. FP32 and integer-only shaders emit no FP64 code.
performance_reason: Double precision is optional in DXVK and vkd3d-proton; their shader-model, feature-level and device-creation requirements do not require it. FP64 operations use software binary64.
off_consequence: D3D11/D3D12 double-precision capabilities and FP64 shader creation are unavailable. Translator shader-model, feature-level and ordinary device-creation requirements are unchanged. Integer64 support is independent.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: integer/FP32 software binary64 on every family; Apple tables provide no FP64 arithmetic.

name: device_generated_commands
description: Generated graphics and compute sequences with push-data and vertex/index-buffer tokens.
cost_class: GPU token expansion / native Metal ICB
cost_note: Used sequences snapshot token bytes and expand root, draw and vertex-input data on the GPU before native ICB execution. Native expansion and command encoding share one dispatch per native ICB slice; graphics crosses from compute to render. Poly stages retain their own expansion. The shared runtime library is compiled only for generated-command or indirect-count execution; application shaders gain no DGC MSL.
performance_reason: Keeps state-changing D3D12 ExecuteIndirect signatures working where vkd3d-proton has no complete fallback; unused DGC adds no application-shader MSL or GPU preprocessing.
off_consequence: ExecuteIndirect tier 1.1 is unavailable; vkd3d-proton can skip state-changing indirect signatures without a DGC template.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Used sequences snapshot token bytes and expand root, draw and vertex-input data on the GPU before native ICB execution. Native expansion and command encoding share one dispatch per native ICB slice; graphics crosses from compute to render. Poly stages retain their own expansion. The shared runtime library is compiled only for generated-command or indirect-count execution; application shaders gain no DGC MSL.

name: draw_indirect_count
description: GPU-counted ordinary multi-draw indirect commands.
cost_class: GPU count filtering / native Metal ICB
cost_note: Large native batches expand active draw records and encode ICB commands in one dispatch per native ICB slice. Other selected routes filter indirect arguments on the GPU and retain their own stage work. Counts remain GPU-resident. No count command adds application-shader MSL. The shared maxDrawIndirectCount limit also serves native fixed-count draws and is retained.
performance_reason: Preserves D3D12 counter-backed ExecuteIndirect and predication semantics; vkd3d-proton returns without executing these commands if drawIndirectCount is unavailable.
off_consequence: Counter-buffer and fallback-predicated ExecuteIndirect commands are skipped by vkd3d-proton. Reported shader model, feature level and device creation do not provide the missing command semantics.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Large native batches expand active draw records and encode ICB commands in one dispatch per native ICB slice. Other selected routes filter indirect arguments on the GPU and retain their own stage work. Counts remain GPU-resident. No count command adds application-shader MSL. The shared maxDrawIndirectCount limit also serves native fixed-count draws and is retained.

name: fragment_barycentric
description: Fragment barycentric coordinates and per-vertex inputs.
cost_note: Legal center-only coordinates use native barycentric_coord. Exact or reordered coordinates and per-vertex inputs transport per-corner values from the producer as flat outputs and interpolate them in the fragment shader. Float4 corner interpolation reads four fragment inputs and performs component arithmetic. AnyPS5 interpolates every pixel shader input exactly when the extension is reported, which places every pixel shader on corner transport; on an Apple8 GPU this measured about 10% more GPU time per present on a title screen.
performance_reason: Applications that use reported barycentric support for all fragment interpolation move every pixel shader to corner transport; AnyPS5 does this and measured about 10% more GPU time per present on an Apple8 title screen.
off_consequence: SV_Barycentrics shaders are unavailable without a translator fallback, and vkd3d-proton disables mesh shaders, so feature level 12.2 requires +fragment_barycentric in addition to its other requirements. The maximum reported shader model is not independently reduced by this entry.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-9: exact per-vertex transport adds fragment inputs and interpolation. On Apple10-11: native pre-raster per-vertex values serve eligible pipelines; exceptional topology and replay paths retain corner transport.

name: fragment_shading_rate
description: Pipeline, primitive and attachment fragment shading rates up to 2x2 pixels.
cost_note: Metal has no per-draw coarse shading. Each Metal quad or half quad forms one fragment: one lane per fragment runs the application side effects and its outputs are broadcast to the other lanes, while the remaining lanes evaluate the neighboring fragments that derivatives need. Inputs are extrapolated to the fragment centers through quad operations, derivatives and implicit texture levels are recomputed, and the final rate is combined in the shader. A pipeline with a static rate state that can select a rate above 1x1 takes this path for every draw, and its root upload includes the full push constant range. A vertex and fragment pipeline with a dynamic rate keeps the fine fragment shader of performance mode and compiles a coarse variant on the first draw whose rate, primitive rate or attachment can exceed 1x1; only those draws bind the variant and upload the rate state. Geometry, tessellation, mesh, transform feedback, line and polygon expansion pipelines with a dynamic rate take the coarse path for every draw. The last vertex stage writes the default 1x1 primitive rate only for a fragment shader that reads it. Metal runs a multisampled fragment shader that uses device atomics once per covered sample. When a multisampled shader on this path writes memory, the real lane of the first sample invocation of each fragment and primitive claims a slot in a 64 MB device table, runs the shader body and publishes its outputs and discard; the real lanes of the other sample invocations wait for that publication and take its values. A slot stays claimed for the rest of its render pass, since Metal runs the fragments of all draws of a pass tile by tile; consecutive render passes use alternate halves of the table, and later render passes reuse the slots. A fragment that finds no free slot within 64 probes runs once per covered sample.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton enables the dynamic rate on every graphics pipeline with render targets when the extension is reported, which would place every pixel shader on the quad-group path.
off_consequence: vkd3d-proton reports variable shading rate tier 0, which keeps Direct3D 12 at feature level 12_1. Multisampled fragment shaders that use device atomics run once per covered sample, as Metal runs them; Vulkan permits these additional invocations outside fragment shading rates.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: Metal variable rasterization rate is a separable map, not Vulkan per-draw primitive/attachment coarse shading. The driver uses quad reconstruction and sample publication on all families.

name: sampler_filter_minmax
description: Minimum and maximum sampler filtering on Apple8 and Apple9 GPUs.
cost_note: Apple10 uses native sampler reduction. Apple8 and Apple9 reduce up to 2^dimensions point taps per filtered mip, with up to two mip footprints and additional anisotropic footprints. Immutable MIN/MAX helpers omit weighted-result dispatch and inline internal taps; ordinary weighted sampling keeps its native path.
performance_reason: DXVK uses min/max filtering for tiled-resource tier 2, which is required for D3D feature level 12_0; only samplers selecting reduction perform software taps.
off_consequence: Disabling min/max filtering can lower DXVK tiled-resource support below tier 2 and remove D3D feature level 12_0.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-9: selected reduction samplers use multiple native taps to retain tiled tier4. On Apple10-11: native sampler reduction.

name: descriptor_heap
description: Descriptor heap addressing and shared image, buffer and sampler metadata.
cost_note: A non-sparse buffer access without robustness checks loads an 8-byte heap root and a 16-byte descriptor packet. A sampled texture and sampler pair loads two 8-byte heap roots and an 8-byte sampler-metadata pointer before shared decoding. Shaders using descriptor sets emit no heap access.
performance_reason: DXVK and vkd3d-proton retain conventional descriptor binding, device creation and D3D shader-model and feature-level support without this optional interface.
off_consequence: The Vulkan heap interface and vkd3d-proton experimental work graphs are unavailable, and byte-offset views require descriptor-buffer support. Conventional descriptor bindings remain available.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: A non-sparse buffer access without robustness checks loads an 8-byte heap root and a 16-byte descriptor packet. A sampled texture and sampler pair loads two 8-byte heap roots and an 8-byte sampler-metadata pointer before shared decoding. Shaders using descriptor sets emit no heap access.

name: zero_initialize_device_memory
description: Explicit zero contents for requested device-memory allocations and ZERO_INITIALIZED images.
cost_note: Each flagged allocation clears the whole BO with CPU stores or a Metal buffer fill and completion wait. ZERO_INITIALIZED images use unoptimized storage to preserve zero bits. No shader instructions are added.
performance_reason: DXVK 3.1.1 and vkd3d-proton 3.1 do not require this allocation extension for D3D shader models, feature levels or device creation; vkd3d-proton retains its resource-clearing path.
off_consequence: D3D shader-model, feature-level and translator device-creation support remain; explicit Vulkan zero-initialized allocation requests and ZERO_INITIALIZED image layout are unavailable.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: Each flagged allocation clears the whole BO with CPU stores or a Metal buffer fill and completion wait. ZERO_INITIALIZED images use unoptimized storage to preserve zero bits. No shader instructions are added.

name: sliced_3d_views
description: Restricted-depth storage views of native 3D textures.
cost_note: Selected 3D storage operations load slice bounds and adjust or reject Z coordinates; image-size queries replace the depth result. The native texture operation is retained. Sparse descriptors can add query-record loads.
performance_reason: Keeps restricted-depth D3D Texture3D UAV semantics; the full-depth vkd3d-proton fallback does not preserve FirstWSlice and WSize.
off_consequence: D3D Texture3D FirstWSlice/WSize UAV semantics are lost; vkd3d-proton reports an unhandled depth view and uses the full depth while its reported SM/FL and device creation remain unchanged.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Selected 3D storage operations load slice bounds and adjust or reject Z coordinates; image-size queries replace the depth result. The native texture operation is retained. Sparse descriptors can add query-record loads.

name: maintenance11_views
description: Single-layer image dimension alias guarantees.
cost_note: Native Metal plain and array views share the existing backing. Shader accesses select a typed descriptor address for the view dimension.
performance_reason: Keeps the D3D single-layer dimension reinterpretation guarantee and typed Metal descriptor selection; the legacy vkd3d-proton natural-view path lacks that guarantee.
off_consequence: D3D single-layer 2D/2D-array descriptor reinterpretation loses its maintenance11 guarantee even though reported SM/FL and device creation are unchanged; DXVK uploads fall back to the graphics queue.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Native Metal plain and array views share the existing backing. Shader accesses select a typed descriptor address for the view dimension.

name: layered_block_views
description: Multiple layers in uncompressed block-compatible views of compressed images.
cost_class: native per-layer views / layer and raster adaptation
cost_note: Native per-layer views share backing, and shader accesses select a layer descriptor. Cube filtering can add taps; layered attachments can use retained raster readers.
performance_reason: DXVK has a per-layer compressed-upload fallback and does not use this optional maintenance6 property to choose D3D SM/FL or require device creation.
off_consequence: Reported D3D SM/FL and translator device creation are unchanged; public multi-layer raw block views are unavailable and DXVK uses per-layer uploads. Other maintenance6 guarantees and internal copy paths remain available.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: Native per-layer views share backing, and shader accesses select a layer descriptor. Cube filtering can add taps; layered attachments can use retained raster readers.

name: transform_feedback
description: Transform-feedback buffer output, geometry streams and stream queries.
cost_note: Active feedback captures producer output, checks buffer capacity and writes enabled components and counters. Raster replay and counter-report dispatches run when the draw uses them.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires transform-feedback queries for device creation, and D3D11 stream output requires the implemented output path.
off_consequence: vkd3d-proton rejects devices without transformFeedbackQueries; D3D11 stream output and dependent generated-primitive queries are unavailable.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Active feedback captures producer output, checks buffer capacity and writes enabled components and counters. Raster replay and counter-report dispatches run when the draw uses them.

name: primitives_generated_query
description: Generated-primitive queries and the shared transform-feedback stream-query reports.
cost_note: Active queries execute counter and report work without per-draw CPU readback. Query-capable geometry pipelines retain report code; native report compilation and dispatch occur when needed.
performance_reason: The shared report path supplies transformFeedbackQueries, which vkd3d-proton requires for device creation.
off_consequence: Generated-primitive queries and shared XFB stream-query reports are unavailable; clearing transformFeedbackQueries prevents vkd3d-proton device creation.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11: Active queries execute counter and report work without per-draw CPU readback. Query-capable geometry pipelines retain report code; native report compilation and dispatch occur when needed.

name: conservative_rasterization
description: Triangle conservative overestimation, degenerate coverage and fully-covered fragment input.
cost_note: Enabled mode captures original vertices, expands coverage and reconstructs original interpolation in the fragment prologue. FullyCovered adds edge tests when read. Static disabled mode emits ordinary vertex and fragment shaders.
performance_reason: Conservative rasterization tier 1 is required for D3D12 feature level 12_1; the implementation also supplies higher-tier coverage behavior.
off_consequence: D3D12 conservative rasterization is unavailable, preventing feature levels 12_1 and 12_2; DXVK reports no D3D11 conservative-rasterization tier.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11 to retain FL12_1: selected conservative draws use capture/expansion; ordinary draws stay native. No family-native conservative path.

name: msrtss
description: Rendering to single-sampled attachments with an implicit multisample color or depth/stencil attachment.
cost_note: Eligible whole-frame color passes use tile storage and native resolve with no expansion shader. LOAD, suspended or split passes retain private multisample backing and expand single-sample contents; unsupported native resolve modes use the shared meta path.
performance_reason: This optional extension has translator fallbacks; LOAD expansion can add a full attachment pass without raising a D3D shader model or feature level.
off_consequence: The extension and its feature are hidden; ANGLE uses its multisample fallback. D3D shader-model and feature-level reporting are unchanged.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: Eligible whole-frame color passes use tile storage and native resolve with no expansion shader. LOAD, suspended or split passes retain private multisample backing and expand single-sample contents; unsupported native resolve modes use the shared meta path.

name: writable_msaa
description: Storage reads, writes and atomics on multisampled color images.
cost_note: Storage operations select a single-sample plane. Attachment and input-attachment consumers convert exact samples to or from the native multisample image. Sampled multisample shaders retain a table-or-native selection when the feature is enabled; single-sampled shaders are unchanged.
performance_reason: Writable multisample textures are optional in vkd3d-proton and do not raise its base shader model or feature level; disabling them retains native MSAA sampling without sample-plane selection.
off_consequence: D3D12 WriteableMSAATexturesSupported becomes false; vkd3d-proton base shader-model, feature-level and device-creation requirements are unchanged. Ordinary MSAA and multisampled local reads remain available.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-11: Storage operations select a single-sample plane. Attachment and input-attachment consumers convert exact samples to or from the native multisample image. Sampled multisample shaders retain a table-or-native selection when the feature is enabled; single-sampled shaders are unchanged.

name: atomic64
description: Full-width buffer and workgroup 64-bit integer atomic operations.
cost_note: Actual atomic64 operations acquire a shared 32-bit hashed lock with CAS retry and two sequential fences. Returned-value operations read two 32-bit words; modifying operations write two words. Unsigned unused-result device min/max uses native assistance from Apple8 within the same mixed-operation lock protocol. Threadgroup operations retain split-word transactions. Operations whose addresses share a hashed lock serialize.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton requires buffer int64 atomics for SM 6.6 and higher; workgroup int64 atomics provide its optional shared-memory atomic capability. Only actual atomic64 instructions select this implementation.
off_consequence: Buffer and workgroup int64 atomics are unavailable; vkd3d-proton cannot advance from SM 6.5 to SM 6.6 and loses AtomicInt64OnGroupSharedSupported. Ordinary shaderInt64 remains independent.
family_cost_note: On Apple7-11 to retain SM6.8: buffer/workgroup operations still use hashed locks and fences; Apple9 limited native atomics do not replace the full API. This is a compatibility-floor cost, not a native-path claim.

name: depth_bounds
description: Depth bounds test on Apple7, Apple8 and Apple9 GPUs.
cost_note: Apple10 uses the native Metal depth bounds test. On earlier families, every draw of a pipeline that enables the test statically, and every draw of a pipeline with a dynamic enable while the test is on, runs in the per-sample depth/stencil transaction: native coverage capture, a load of the stored depth and stencil, ordered bounds, depth and stencil tests in bounded tile and primitive batches, and replay of the passing samples. Ordinary, Mesh and generated Mesh draws use the same transaction. A pipeline with a dynamic enable also compiles the unchanged pipeline, which its draws, and generated commands without an execution set, bind while the test is off. Pipelines that do not enable the test compile and run unchanged. While the feature is enabled, color and depth/stencil attachment images also receive shader-read usage.
performance_reason: vkd3d-proton enables depthBounds whenever it is reported, which gives every attachment image shader-read usage and runs each pipeline state object that enables the bounds test through the software transaction.
off_consequence: On Apple7, Apple8 and Apple9, depthBounds is unavailable; vkd3d-proton reports DepthBoundsTestSupported as false, which limits Direct3D 12 to feature level 12_1, and fails creation of pipeline states that enable the depth bounds test.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7-9: per-sample depth/stencil replay. On Apple10-11: native Metal depth bounds.

name: image_atomic64
description: 64-bit integer atomics and R64_UINT and R64_SINT storage images and storage texel buffers on Apple7 GPUs.
cost_class: native Apple8 texture min/max / hashed locks
cost_note: Image operations take the shared hashed lock keyed by texel coordinates, with CAS retry and two sequential fences. Apple8 and later publish each result with one native unsigned 64-bit texture minimum or maximum. Apple7 reads and writes the two 32-bit words of the RG32Uint texel under the lock and creates R64 images without Metal texture atomics. Texel-buffer operations use the buffer atomic64 transaction. Shaders without 64-bit image operations are unchanged.
performance_reason: On Apple7 the entry raises only vkd3d-proton sampler feedback to tier 0.9 and typed-resource 64-bit atomics; performance mode reports feature level 12_1 with or without it.
off_consequence: On Apple7, VK_EXT_shader_image_atomic_int64 and the R64_UINT and R64_SINT storage image and storage texel buffer formats are unavailable; vkd3d-proton reports sampler feedback tier 0 and no typed-resource 64-bit atomics, so feature level 12_2 is unavailable.
family_cost_note: Off Apple7: split-word image transactions. On Apple8-11: native texture min/max publishes under the existing mixed-operation lock; sampler feedback tier0.9. The lock remains real work.
